main_visual_task: On stage she presents the bouquet with both hands; the singer steps down half a stair and bows to receive it with both hands, then stands beside her facing the red sea while the giant screen behind switches to their two-shot; camera flashes freeze them into a saved photograph.

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same young Chinese woman from the reference photo: soft oval face, fair skin, thin round metal-frame glasses, dark brown mid-parted hair past her shoulders, matte red-brown lips, loose bright-red long-sleeve tee, fine necklace; and the same Chinese male pop singer around thirty: slim, silver-gray highlighted short hair, black stage shirt, red microphone
prompt_bible.environment_lock: open-air stadium main stage at night; giant curved LED screen behind; stage-edge stairs on frame left; red glow sea beyond the stage lights; volume haze in the beams; no other person ever resolves in frame
prompt_bible.material_lock: real skin pores with faint sweat sheen, kraft paper and velvet rose petals, black shirt fabric weave, matte microphone body, LED screen pixel glow softly diffused by haze; every contact physically plausible
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: one follow-spot-language world: front follow-spot on the pair, red ambient from the sea, cool screen backlight behind them; flash sequence in B4-B5 as true white strobes; shadows obey the follow-spot
prompt_bible.palette_lock: night blue-black base, ember red (bouquet, tee, sea, screen), warm skin, silver hair accent, then pure white flashes
prompt_bible.lens_texture: live-action 35mm cinema camera, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, no gimbal smoothness; the final photograph freeze carries true photo grain
prompt_bible.screen_direction: she stands frame left, he stands frame right, facing camera together from B3; his receiving step comes down toward frame left
prompt_bible.audio_policy: no dialogue; crowd swell, one warm instrumental rise, flash shutter clicks, a held breath before the last flash; exact sound mix in post
